recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13787 unless FHIR-I opens a later issue to change the broader reference-resolution model.
issue_request: FHIR-13787 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I issue for FHIR-core-Feed. It reported that the Reference documentation incorrectly said a bundle relative URL was relative to Bundle.entry.fullUrl itself, and the approved resolution changed that text to say a reference in a bundle is relative to the base URL implied by Bundle.entry.fullUrl.
initial_application: Jira records Grahame Grieve's application comment as svn revision 12792. Git history preserves that SVN import as b4ab76b58dbfe3f45bb5f3ca1b36ec6169973a43, with message '#13787 = fix note about resolving references in a bundle' and the same source/references.html wording change requested by Jira.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps Reference to references.html and lists Bundle as an active/normative resource. The current Bundle reference-resolution notes explain deriving the base/root from Bundle.entry.fullUrl and undefined expectations when fullURLs are missing. Later fullUrl issue-family decisions, including FHIR-15139, FHIR-16909, and FHIR-31422, refine URI/endpoint semantics without reversing this base-URL clarification. A related Zulip thread discussed literal and relative reference ambiguity but did not identify a conflicting work-group decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/references.html already says relative URLs are relative to the Service Base URL or, when processing a resource from a bundle, to the base URL implied by Bundle.entry.fullUrl. The combined branch had the same corrected wording.
